title: Green Pineapple Smoothie
subtitle: Green · Green
description: Spinach disappears behind pineapple and coconut water. This is how you get greens in without the “salad in a cup” face from the crew.
intro: Spinach disappears behind pineapple and coconut water. This is how you get greens in without the “salad in a cup” face from the crew.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Green Pineapple Smoothie in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Blend. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Blend spinach with coconut
steps.instruction: Blend spinach with coconut water first until no leaf flecks remain — this step prevents green stringiness. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add pineapple, banana, and
steps.instruction: Add pineapple, banana, and lime. Blend on high until smooth and bright green. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: The color should look
steps.instruction: The color should look tropical, not muddy. Add ice only if you want it colder and thicker. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Serve cold within a
steps.instruction: Serve cold within a few hours; oxidation will dull the color but it is still fine to drink. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

substitutions: Kale works but blanch flavor is stronger — use half spinach, half kale.
Regular water replaces coconut water in a pinch.
shiftNote: Light enough for early morning or post-call when heavy food sounds wrong. Good “reset” option.
proTips: Light enough for early morning or post-call when heavy food sounds wrong. Good “reset” option.
Rinse the blender jar between batches so flavors do not muddy the next crew's cups.
If tones drop during service, cover hot food and hold at 140°F — note hold time on the pan for food safety.
tonightSpread: Pour Green Pineapple Smoothie into insulated cups or quart jars on ice for grab-and-go service.
Set granola, nut butter, and extra fruit in side bowls so crew can customize without slowing the line.
Keep a backup blender batch chilled at 38°F if service runs past 20 minutes.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
